props.title: Okra Studio
props.text: A small type foundry. Three typefaces, drawn slowly, licensed simply. The doors open in the spring.

items.title: Okra Text
items.text: A reading face in eight weights, with real italics.

items.title: Okra Mono
items.text: For code and tables. Friendly zeros.

items.title: Gumbo
items.text: A loud display face for posters and jam jars.

items.title: One licence
items.text: Web, print and apps for one price. No pageview counting.

props.title: One email, on opening day
props.text: We will write once, on 2 May, with a discount for the first week. Then never again unless you ask.
